description: Depth-3 numerical witness for conj:bring-trilog-depth-3-witness — the depth-3 instance of the keystone conjecture conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence.  Computes Li_3 at the primitive 5th root of unity zeta_5 (Bring-natural input via S_5 symmetry of Bring's curve).  Real and imaginary parts both lie in weight-3 Goncharov period class P_3/P_2.  Cross-validated by the Bring-orbit sum identity sum_{k=1}^4 Li_3(zeta_5^k) = (5^{-2} - 1) * zeta(3), which agrees to better than 1e-45 at 50 dps.

shape_parameter.S5_symmetry_motivation: Bring's curve has S_5 symmetry; zeta_5 generates Q(zeta_5), the natural cyclotomic field for S_5-equivariant moduli of Bring.

depth_correspondence.interpretation: Li_3 grouplike at algebraic point (zeta_5) maps under tau_arch to weight-3 Goncharov period.  Both real (Cl_3) and imaginary (S_3) components are P_3/P_2 elements; bar involution exchanges them via complex conjugation.

open_question_geometric_realisation: Identifying a hyperbolic 4-manifold or Chern-Simons invariant whose volume / regulator equals Re Li_3(zeta_5) or Im Li_3(zeta_5) is open.  The natural candidates are (a) hyperbolic 4-manifolds with cusps shaped on Bring's S_5-orbit, (b) CS invariants of S_5-symmetric knots in S^3, (c) iterated integrals on the moduli space of Bring's curve.
